SELJUK ARTS OF WAR REFERENCE
Source: Seljuk Playbook (Background Book), pp. 24-35, paired with card text.
Each card has a top half (Event, no Lord indicator) and a bottom half (Capability, with Lord indicator).
Clarifications from the playbook are integrated and trump the printed card text where they conflict.
An asterisk (*) on a card name denotes a once-per-game / specially-tracked card.
 
================================================================
ROMAN CARDS
================================================================
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R1. FLOODED RIVER CROSSING* / IMPERIAL FORTRESS CONSTRUCTION
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Flooded River Crossing*
Alp Arslan immediately undergoes Wastage 3 times (mark).
If already marked, 1 Seljuk Lord -1 Lordship this Muster (Seljuk choice) instead.
 
Clarification. The Seljuk player decides on the Wastage. If after executing a Wastage on Alp Arslan he does not qualify for further Wastage (because he only has 1 of each Asset or Capability), the Event effect ends; he is never forced to remove an Asset if he only has a single Asset of each type or Capability card. When using the "if already marked" effect, the selected Lord must be one able to Muster this turn, if possible.
 
CAPABILITY - Imperial Fortress Construction (Any)
Put 2 Fort markers on this card. As a Command action, this Lord may place a Fort marker on an unfortified Locale (including Ruined) in the Roman Empire (1.3.1).
 
Clarification. The Fort markers are placed when the Capability is Levied. The Lord does not have to be at the Locale in which he uses this card to place a Fort. A Seljuk Ruins marker is removed from the Locale when a Fort marker is placed (adjust VP). If both Fort markers are on the map, this Capability has no effect.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R2. MOUNTAIN AMBUSH / OGHUZ MERCENARIES
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Mountain Ambush
HOLD: May play in Battle if that Locale is adjacent to Pass. Round 1, Roman Walls 1-3 against Missiles.
 
Clarification. A Locale is adjacent to a Pass if one of its connected Ways is a Pass. The map's two holding boxes do not qualify as Pass even though March from them takes the entire card.
 
CAPABILITY - Oghuz Mercenaries (Any)
Add the Oghuz Mercenaries special Vassal to this Lord's mat.
 
Clarification. After spending the Lordship to Muster this Capability and place the special Vassal marker in the Assets section of his Lord mat, it takes an additional Lordship to Muster the Vassal to the Lord's Forces and receive the unit. If this card is discarded, remove the Vassal Force(s).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R3. SUMMER HEAT / STEELED RESOLVE
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Summer Heat
HOLD: Play in Summer after Seljuks reveal Command card. That Lord is Command 1.
 
Clarification. This effect takes place before any Command actions are performed after revealing the Command card. This card does not prevent Commands that cost an entire card like Tax, March from a holding box, etc.
 
CAPABILITY - Steeled Resolve (Any)
This Lord's Infantry have Armor 1-4 vs. Horse in any 1 Round of Battle (mark).
 
Clarification. The Armor 1-4 effect applies to both Missile and Melee. Account for Hits from the Javelins Capability separately from Horse Missiles during Battle when using this Capability. Use the Capability's marker to indicate this card's effect.
 
[CORRECTION (D-002, 2026-06-09): both Armor values above were transcribed as "1-3"; corrected to "1-4". Derived from the Player Aid Forces table (Infantry base Armor 1-3, confirmed by Eric) plus the no-op argument (a Capability granting the value Infantry already have would be a dead card half), NOT from published errata. If official Errata later addresses R3, the Errata file takes precedence over this derived correction. Residual check: confirm the printed R3 card reads "1-4"; if it reads "1-3", the no-op exists in the published game and is an upstream errata candidate, but the engine implements 1-4 regardless.]
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R4. SULTAN'S HORSE IS KILLED / PRESSED LEVY SERVICE
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Sultan's Horse Is Killed
HOLD: Play where Alp Arslan Besieging Stronghold with >1 Siege marker: remove 1 Siege from Locale. OR play during Storm to reduce number of Rounds by 1.
 
Clarification. If used for the first effect, this card is played during Campaign when it is the Roman player's turn. If using for the second effect, it is played during the Play Events step of Storm. For either choice, the card can only be played on a Locale that has more than 1 Siege marker where Alp Arslan is located.
 
CAPABILITY - Pressed Levy Service (ALL)
Romans may keep 1 Unpaid Thema's Levied Themata with Lord at end of each Campaign.
 
Clarification. The Lord may keep all Levied Themata Service Markers from the chosen Thema at no cost. This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge. Use the Capability marker to indicate this card's effect.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R5. FATIMID CONFLICT / NORMAN HEAVY CAVALRY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Fatimid Conflict
Shift any 1 Seljuk cylinder or Service of Unbesieged Lord 1 Calendar box.
 
Clarification. This shift can be in any direction, Roman player's choice.
 
CAPABILITY - Norman Heavy Cavalry (Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
This Lord may reroll 1 Norman Knights' Armor each Missiles AND Melee step.
 
Clarification. The reroll may be used on a different unit in Missiles and Melee. It is two rerolls: one during Missiles, and one during either Horse or Infantry Melee (not both).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R6. MICHAEL ATTALEIATES / CENTRALIZED ADMINISTRATION
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Michael Attaleiates
HOLD: Play on Romanos during Muster for Lordship +1.
 
Clarification. This card is played at any time during the Roman Muster phase.
 
CAPABILITY - Centralized Administration (Any, except Chatatourios, Robert Crépin, and Roussel de Bailleul)
This Lord beginning his activation inside the Roman Empire with a Supply Route gets +1 Command.
 
Clarification. "Inside the Roman Empire" means beginning his activation at a Locale to the west of the border with the Sultanate, regardless of who controls that Locale. This +1 Command applies even if that Lord leaves the Roman Empire during his activation. Supply Routes are defined in 4.4.1.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R7. BASIL ALOUSIANOS TRICKS THE SULTAN* / EMPEROR'S RETINUE
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Basil Alousianos Tricks the Sultan*
HOLD: Play as Roman Stronghold Surrenders on roll of 3 or less. Do not place Conquered; replace all Siege with Bypass (mark).
If marked, discard and draw new event.
 
Clarification. "Surrender on 3 or less" means the die roll needed to cause a Surrender (i.e., the Locale has some combination of 3 or more Siege and Ravaged markers). This Event cannot be played if there is a combination of four Siege + Ravaged markers at the Locale.
 
CAPABILITY - Emperor's Retinue (Romanos Diogenes)
Add the Emperor's Retinue special Vassal to this Lord's mat.
Vassal contents: 1x Varangian Guard, 1x Hetaireia, Service 1.
 
Clarification. After spending the Lordship to Muster this Capability and place the special Vassal marker in the Assets section of his Lord mat, it takes an additional Lordship to Muster the Vassal to the Lord's Forces and receive the units. If this card is discarded, remove the Vassal Force(s).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R8. ROMAN PERSUASION / MARTIAL SOCIETY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Roman Persuasion
Add your Treachery card to this Season's Command Deck during Plan phase (4.1). Seljuk must add 1 No Command.
 
Clarification. The Treachery card is in addition to the normal Command cards called for by the Season. If both players add their Treachery card in the same turn, both players also still add a No Command to the deck (meaning there will be two extra cards: the Treachery and a No Command) in each.
 
CAPABILITY - Martial Society (Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
This Lord is Command +1.
 
Clarification. This effect only lasts while the card is Mustered as a Capability.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R9. WINTER CAMPAIGN / PROVINCIAL BUREAUCRACY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Winter Campaign
HOLD: Play in Winter before Bounty to activate a Roman Lord.
 
Clarification. The Roman Lord may be Besieged. If both players play Winter Campaign / Winter March at the same time, the Seljuk player goes first, followed by the Roman player.
 
CAPABILITY - Provincial Bureaucracy (Any Commander: Romanos Diogenes or Manuel Komnenos)
This Lord's first Tax Command outside Constantinople each Campaign does not place Ravaged.
 
Clarification. The Lord may Tax the same Locale a second time on a future Command card this Season, but if it is not his Seat, it will place a Ravaged marker.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R10. AFŞIN MURDERS SELJUK OFFICER* / RECONQUISTA & SICILIAN COMMANDERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Afşin Murders Seljuk Officer*
Afşin Beg's Fealty is 2 (mark).
If already marked, 1 Seljuk Lord -1 Lordship this Muster (Seljuk choice) instead.
 
Clarification. His Fealty will be considered 2 for all game effects. When using the "if already marked" effect, the selected Lord must be one able to Muster this turn, if possible.
 
CAPABILITY - Reconquista & Sicilian Commanders (Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
This Lord's Lordship +1.
 
Clarification. This effect only lasts while the card is Mustered as a Capability.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R11. CHRYSOSKOULOS COUNSELS THE COURT / KLIBANOPHOROI
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Chrysoskoulos Counsels the Court
If Arisighi Roman ally, Seljuks discard 1 random Held card.
 
Clarification. If the Seljuk player has no Hold cards, there is no effect.
 
CAPABILITY - Klibanophoroi (Any)
This Lord's Tagmata have Armor 1-4.
 
Clarification. This effect only lasts while the card is Mustered as a Capability. Armor 1-4 is against both Missiles and Melee. This increased Protection is not used for Losses after Battle.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R12. AFŞIN RECALLED / EMPRESS EUDOKIA MAKREMBOLITISSA
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Afşin Recalled
Shift Afşin Beg's cylinder or Service 1 Calendar box.
 
Clarification. This shift can be in either direction, Roman player's choice.
 
CAPABILITY - Empress Eudokia Makrembolitissa (ALL)
Make the Empress token available for use each Call to Arms (3.5.1.2).
 
Clarification. The Empress token begins play on this card when Mustered. This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R13. THRAKION REINFORCEMENTS / SYNDOSIS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Thrakion Reinforcements
Return a Themata Service Marker previously removed from play to its home Thema.
 
Clarification. This returning Themata Service Marker must be placed in its Thema box, not on a Lord mat or inside a Besieged Stronghold. Players are advised to create a pile beside the board for Themata for game effects that remove or return them to play.
 
CAPABILITY - Syndosis (Andronikos Doukas and Chatatourios)
This Lord's Militia have Armor 1-2.
 
Clarification. This effect only lasts while the card is Mustered as a Capability. Armor 1-2 is against both Missiles and Melee. This increased Protection is not used for Losses after Battle.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R14. ALEPPO INDEPENDENCE / IMPERIAL COFFERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Aleppo Independence
Unless Aleppo Conquered (by either side), it is Friendly to both sides (mark), but neither may Withdraw inside. Aleppo can now yield Seljuk auto victory (5.2).
 
Clarification. If Aleppo is already Conquered when this Event is revealed, the Event has no effect. In this instance, this Event does not trigger the ability for the Seljuk player to win the game during Winter for holding Aleppo.
 
CAPABILITY - Imperial Coffers (ALL)
Discard during Arts of War if Roman adjacent to Seljuk-allied Robert or Roussel: make 1 Loyalty Check against that Lord.
May not be Levied if neither is Seljuk-allied.
 
Clarification. Any Roman Lord may be the one adjacent in order to discard this Capability for its effect. Discard this card after both players have drawn their Events in the Arts of War phase. Discard this card for its effect only after both players have resolved their Events. This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R15. EMIR OF ALEPPO SPURNS ALP ARSLAN* / FEALTY TO THE BASILEUS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Emir of Aleppo Spurns Alp Arslan*
If Aleppo Seljuk Conquered and no Siege marker, place Independent Aleppo. If already present, place Roman Conquered instead. Adjust VP (mark).
If already marked (or no event effect), discard and draw new Event instead.
 
Clarification. The Event has no effect (discard and draw a new one) if any of the following is true: an Enemy Seljuk Lord is present in Aleppo when this Event is revealed; Aleppo is Roman Conquered. "If already present" means the Independent Aleppo marker is already on the map. Once this Event occurs, either by placing the Independent Aleppo marker or causing Aleppo to become Roman Conquered, its once-per-game effect is considered triggered (mark the Calendar) and it cannot occur again.
 
CAPABILITY - Fealty to the Basileus (Any)
This Lord may choose not to return to Seat in Winter.
 
Clarification. The Lord may stay in his current Locale, even if Besieging a Stronghold. If he chooses to return, he may not return to another Lord's Seat, another Locale, etc.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R16. ANGLO-SAXON EXILES / ARMENIAN GARRISONS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Anglo-Saxon Exiles
If available, add 1 Varangian Guard unit to any Roman Lord mat (not Robert or Roussel) if he has no Varangian Guard.
 
Clarification. If neither of the two Varangian Guard are available (because both units are already with a Lord), or there are no Roman Lords who are not Robert or Roussel in play, this Event has no effect.
 
CAPABILITY - Armenian Garrisons (ALL)
All Roman-conquered Strongholds outside Roman Empire (1.3.1) use both Seljuk and Roman Garrison units.
 
Clarification. Read this literally: when generating Garrison units, receive the units from both sides of the Garrisons chart (e.g., if a Fort, receive 2 Militia and 1 Infantry). This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R17. UNPREDICTABLE WEATHER / SCHOLAI
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Unpredictable Weather
This Campaign, if Spring or Autumn, Passes cannot be used for Supply, March, Avoid Battle, or Retreat. If Summer, Plan stack (4.1) is 9 cards. Seljuk player must use 1 No Command.
 
Clarification. The enemy player adding a No Command happens only if this event occurs in Summer.
 
CAPABILITY - Scholai (Romanos Diogenes and Andronikos Doukas)
Add the Scholai Service Marker to this Lord's mat.
Vassal contents: 1x Hetaireia, Service 1.
 
Clarification. After spending the Lordship to Muster this Capability and place the special Vassal marker in the Assets section of his Lord mat, it takes an additional Lordship to Muster the Vassal to the Lord's Forces and receive the unit. If this card is discarded, remove the Vassal Force(s).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R18. LOCAL SCOUTS / ICON OF THE VIRGIN MARY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Local Scouts
HOLD: Play as Enemy Avoids Battle. Enemy chooses 1 Avoiding Lord to Battle or Withdraw instead.
 
Clarification. The other Enemy Lords not selected must follow through with the original Avoid Battle decision. Choosing Withdraw may only occur at a Friendly Stronghold (except a Friendly Aleppo). Resolve the Avoid Battle before Battle begins.
 
CAPABILITY - Icon of the Virgin Mary (Any)
Discard this card when calculating Losses after Battle: this Lord's routed units recover per armor, regardless of situation.
 
Clarification. "Regardless of situation" means ignoring any penalties to Losses after Battle, the effects of other cards, or whether or not the Lord discarding the Capability Conceded the Field. Use of this card always guarantees the Lord may roll against Routed units' Protection.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R19. RESILIENT AGRICULTURE / NOMISMA DEBASED*
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Resilient Agriculture
Remove 2 Ravaged Markers from the Roman Empire (1.3.1).
 
Clarification. Only Seljuk Ravaged markers may be removed. The Roman player may not choose Ravaged markers in the Fatimid Caliphate. Remove as many as possible, and removal is mandatory.
 
CAPABILITY - Nomisma Debased* (ALL)
Discard during Pay step of Levy to shift all Roman Service 1 Calendar box. Non-Commander Roman Lords may not Tax for rest of game (mark).
 
Clarification. This Capability can only be triggered once per game. The Roman player may pay none, some, or all of their Lords with Coin or Loot before discarding this card for its effect. Commander Lords (Romanos Diogenes and Manuel Komnenos) are exempt from the Tax prohibition and may continue to Tax. This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R20. ARMENIAN RESISTANCE / SIEGE WEAPONRY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Armenian Resistance
If Khliat, Manzikert, or Arkesh is Seljuk friendly, choose one and place Roman Conquered Marker. Adjust VP.
 
Clarification. If the chosen listed Locale has a Seljuk Lord present, the Seljuk player immediately places a Siege or Bypass marker there (Seljuk choice). If there is a Strategic Objective marker at this Locale, return it to available (do not place it in Constantinople as VP).
 
CAPABILITY - Siege Weaponry (Any, except Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
This Lord unrouted at Storm reduces Enemy Walls -1.
 
Clarification. This effect only persists while the Lord is Unrouted; if he becomes Routed during the Storm, enemy Walls return to their normal value. This Capability is also in effect if the Lord is in Reserve.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R21. NOMADIC TRIBES GO ROGUE / BARDOUKIA
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Nomadic Tribes Go Rogue
HOLD: Play before Battle or Storm to remove up to 2 Turkic Horse units at the Active Lord's Locale from play.
 
Clarification. The removed units are eliminated immediately, with no roll to recover as after Battle. This event can affect a Besieged Lord, or a Lord not taking part in the Battle. This can occur to a Lord who only has two Turkic Horse units, thereby causing a Disband.
 
CAPABILITY - Bardoukia (Any)
This Lord's Tagmata inflict -1 to target armor during each Melee Strike step of Battle.
 
Clarification. The recipient of Bardoukia attacks is advised to roll Protection against these hits separately from other hits during the same Melee step.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R22. ASSASSINATION PLOT IN TYRE / CAVALRY SUPPLY LINE RAIDERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Assassination Plot in Tyre
Unless Ibn Khan within 2 Locales of Aleppo, permanently Disband him. Otherwise, shift his Service 1 Calendar box.
 
Clarification. Being 2 Locales away from Aleppo is considered "within" (for example, Manbij, Artah, Laodikeia, and Jazira). This shift can be in any direction, Roman player's choice, and may cause Disband. Having only Turkic Horse does not help to be considered closer.
 
CAPABILITY - Cavalry Supply Line Raiders (Any)
During Wastage, 1 Enemy Lord adjacent to This Lord undergoes Wastage twice.
 
Clarification. The second occurrence of Wastage caused by this card does not happen if after the first Wastage procedure, the enemy Lord does not qualify for triggering Wastage (i.e., they only have a single Asset of all types on their Lord mat). In the case of multiple adjacent Lords, the Roman player chooses which Lord suffers the Wastage.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R23. KLEISOURAI / ALAKATIA
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Kleisourai
HOLD: Play when Seljuk Lord Marches, Avoids Battle, or Retreats across Pass. Each moving Seljuk Lord takes 1 Hit (as if in Battle, no Losses roll).
 
Clarification. The Seljuk player still gets to roll Protection for the unit assigned the Hit, but if the Protection roll fails, the unit is eliminated with no roll to recover as after a Battle.
 
CAPABILITY - Alakatia (Any)
This Lord with 2 Infantry in Battle adds 1 extra Missile Hit with -1 to target armor.
 
Clarification. The defender should roll the extra Hit from Alakatia separately in most cases since it has the same special anti-armor effect as Garrison Missiles. If during a subsequent round of the same Battle the Lord has less than 2 Unrouted Infantry, he does not strike with the extra Hit (i.e., the Capability does not take effect). A Lord with more than 2 Infantry does not generate extra Hits (e.g., 4 Infantry does not cause 2 Hits).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R24. CAVALRY CHARGE / MULES
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Cavalry Charge
HOLD: Play on 1 Roman Lord in Battle. Round 1, that Lord's Horse Melee precedes all Missiles.
 
Clarification. The Horse units that Melee Strike before Missiles skip their usual Melee Strike phase (after Missiles) that round. If this card is played at the same time as Command Confusion, Cavalry Charge takes precedence.
 
CAPABILITY - Mules (Any)
This Lord's first March across Pass spends only 1 Command even if Laden.
 
Clarification. This effect applies once each Command card. This effect does not occur for this Lord if stacked under a Lieutenant or being moved by a Commander as part of a Group March.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
R25. HONORS OF WAR / PSILOI
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Honors of War
HOLD: Play during Siege on Fort; instead of rolling, Fort automatically Surrenders. Take no Spoils.
 
Clarification. The active Lord must still take a Siege action in order for this card to be played.
 
CAPABILITY - Psiloi (ALL)
Roman Militia have Missiles x½.
 
Clarification. The effect of this card applies to all non-garrison Roman Militia in play (Roman Garrison militia already have Missile x½ with -1 to Armor as default). This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
 
================================================================
SELJUK CARDS
================================================================
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S1. SURPRISE / LAMELLAR ARMOR (1 of 2 copies)
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Surprise
HOLD: Play upon Besieging an enemy Fort or Town where no other Lord. Place 2 Siege there (not 1), then Storm.
 
Clarification. The Roman player still gets to place his Themata (if any) as normal before the Siege markers are placed.
 
CAPABILITY - Lamellar Armor (Emir of Arran, Alp Arslan, and Artuk Beg)
This Lord's Turkic Horse have Armor 1-3 until 3 Rout.
 
Clarification. Immediately upon 3 Turkic Horse units Routing from this Lord, the effect of the Capability no longer applies for the remainder of that Battle. If this Lord has less than 3 Turkic Horse units on their mat, this Capability will always be in effect. (S1 and S2 each carry a copy of this Capability.)
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S2. MOUNTAIN AMBUSH / LAMELLAR ARMOR (2 of 2 copies)
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Mountain Ambush
HOLD: May play in Battle if that Locale is adjacent to Pass. Round 1, Seljuk Walls 1-3 against Missiles.
 
Clarification. A Locale is adjacent to a Pass if one of its connected Ways is a Pass. The map's two holding boxes do not qualify as Pass even though March from them takes the entire card.
 
CAPABILITY - Lamellar Armor (Emir of Arran, Alp Arslan, and Artuk Beg)
Identical to S1 Bottom. See S1 above.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S3. THE BETRAYAL OF ANDRONIKOS DOUKAS* / STEPPE RAIDERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - The Betrayal of Andronikos Doukas*
HOLD: Play after Reposition step in Battle. If more than one enemy Lord, move a non-Commander Roman Lord to Reserve.
 
Clarification. The Roman Lord selected must be a Lord in the left, right, or center position of array, and he may rejoin the Battle in a subsequent round during Reposition. This Event can only occur once per game. Place the appropriate marker on the Calendar in the turn it is played. If the card is drawn as an Event in future turns, treat it as No Event and return it to the Arts of War deck.
 
CAPABILITY - Steppe Raiders (Sanduq al-Turki, Arisighi, and Ibn Khan)
This Lord may Ravage adjacent Locales where no enemy Lord if he has Turkic Horse.
 
Clarification. Adjacent includes across a Pass. These adjacent Ravages may be defended per the normal rules, depending on how many Command actions were spent.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S4. SUMMER HEAT / SHOCK TACTICS (1 of 2 copies)
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Summer Heat
HOLD: Play in Summer after Romans reveal Command card. That Lord is Command 1.
 
Clarification. This effect takes place before any Command actions are performed after revealing the Command card. This card does not prevent Commands that cost an entire card like Tax, March from a holding box, etc.
 
CAPABILITY - Shock Tactics (Any)
Half of this Lord's Turkic Horse have Melee x½ (round up).
 
Clarification. Because you round up when determining number of units, a single Turkic Horse unit will still strike at x½ and do 1 Hit with this Capability. (S4 and S6 each carry a copy of this Capability.)
 
Errata (Playbook p.14). Half (rounded up) of Alp Arslan's 3 Turkic Horse means 2 units doing x½ Hits each, for a total of 1 Hit (after rounding).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S5. SIEGE OF BARI* / FORCED CONSCRIPTION
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Siege of Bari*
Remove from play 2 Unlevied Themata (mark).
If already marked, 1 Seljuk Lord +1 Lordship this Muster (Seljuk choice) instead.
 
Clarification. Unlevied Themata are Unbesieged Themata Service Markers not currently located on the Roman Commander's mat or already removed from play.
 
CAPABILITY - Forced Conscription (Sav-Tekin)
Each Muster phase, this Lord at Unbesieged Friendly Locale may restore 1 of his Lost units.
 
Clarification. This is in addition to his normal Muster actions using his Lordship. The recovered unit must be either one of his Levied Vassals or his original Forces.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S6. COMMAND CONFUSION / SHOCK TACTICS (2 of 2 copies)
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Command Confusion
HOLD: Play on Roman Lord in Battle. His Missiles and Melee each Strike second.
 
Clarification. In each phase of Battle (missile and then melee), the affected Lord does his Hits after the Seljuk player's Lord(s) regardless of who is defending or attacking. If this card is played at the same time as Cavalry Charge, Cavalry Charge takes precedence.
 
CAPABILITY - Shock Tactics (Any)
Identical to S4 Bottom. See S4 above.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S7. DESERTERS / TRUSTED COMMANDER
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Deserters
Remove from play 1 Themata from a Thema adjacent to the Sultanate.
 
Clarification. Remove a Themata Service Marker from a border Thema (Iberia, Mesopotamia, Melitene, Antiocheia), not a levied Themata Service Marker on the Roman Commander's mat.
 
CAPABILITY - Trusted Commander (Emir of Arran, Artuk Beg, and Sav-Tekin)
This Lord may March as Commander with 1 (only) other Seljuk Lord.
 
Clarification. This Capability does not confer the "Commander" icon or status as found on Alp Arslan's mat; it is for March only.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S8. CALIPHATE MERCHANT FINANCING / MARWANID ALLIANCE
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Caliphate Merchant Financing
1 Seljuk Lord may exchange any of his Carts for Coin or vice versa.
 
Clarification. This effect takes place immediately after the Event is revealed, and the chosen Lord may exchange none, some, or all of his Carts for an equal number of Coins. The chosen Seljuk Lord may only use this effect for his own Carts on his mat.
 
CAPABILITY - Marwanid Alliance (ALL)
May now spend Coin to create special Seljuk Seats during Call to Arms (3.5.1.1).
 
Clarification. Use the Seljuk Seat markers on the map as a reminder of this process (3.5.1.1). This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S9. ALP ARSLAN'S MOUSTACHE / IMPERIAL RIVALRY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Alp Arslan's Moustache
This Campaign, Alp Arslan Forage rolls -2.
 
Clarification. This effect only applies to Alp Arslan, and not Lords co-located at his Locale.
 
CAPABILITY - Imperial Rivalry (ALL)
Each Levy, Romans must attempt once to Muster Andronikos Doukas if Ready.
 
Clarification. This attempt can come from any Lord's Lordship action as chosen by the Roman player in whatever order they choose. This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S10. EASTERN REBELLIONS DEFEATED / ARTUKID LEGACY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Eastern Rebellions Defeated
HOLD: Play on Alp Arslan during Muster for Lordship +1.
 
Clarification. This card is played at any time during the Seljuk Muster phase.
 
CAPABILITY - Artukid Legacy (Artuk Beg)
This Lord may always use Mayyafariqin and Amid as Supply Source and for returning Loot during Bounty (4.7.6).
 
Clarification. With this Capability, Artuk Beg may treat these two cities as Seats for Supply Route and returning Loot during Winter Bounty purposes for himself only, regardless of whether Marwanid Alliance is in effect. Loot from Bounty is placed in the Mosul and Baghdad Holding Box as normal.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S11. NORMAN SCHEMING / JAVELINS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Norman Scheming
If Roussel or Robert Seljuk Ally, Romans discard 1 random Held card.
 
Clarification. If the Roman player has no Held cards, there is no effect.
 
CAPABILITY - Javelins (Sav-Tekin and Emir of Arran)
This Lord's Infantry have Missiles x1 in any 1 Battle Round.
 
Clarification. The player chooses which round of battle to use the Capability (use the Javelins marker to indicate when it's been spent). Javelins can be used in every Battle (but not Storm). Account for Hits from the Javelins Capability separately from Horse Missiles during Battle when Steeled Resolve Capability is present.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S12. DOUKAI COURT INTRIGUES / THE SICKLE OF ANATOLIA
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Doukai Court Intrigues
Shift any 1 Roman cylinder or Service 1 Calendar box.
 
Clarification. This shift can be in any direction, Seljuk player's choice.
 
CAPABILITY - The Sickle of Anatolia (Afşin Beg)
This Lord is Command +1.
 
Clarification. This effect lasts only while the card is levied. This card allows only one more Command action, not a Command Action that requires All plus an additional Command.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S13. PEACE OFFERING / GIFTS EXCHANGED
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Peace Offering
This Season, no Approach, Storm, or Siege unless that Lord pays 1 Coin that Command card. Add Gifts Exchanged (this card) to Seljuk Levied Capabilities.
 
Clarification. The Coin is paid immediately before undertaking one of the listed prohibited Command actions, but those Command actions may be taken at any point during the acting Lord's Command card. Lords Besieging a Locale may remain Besieging that Locale but cannot take the Siege Command unless a Coin is paid under normal payment rules (e.g., the Coin can be from the Besieging Lord or from Alp Arslan if he is Unbesieged and on the map).
 
CAPABILITY - Gifts Exchanged (ALL)
Muster only if Friendly and Enemy Lords adjacent. Put 4 Coin on this card. Seljuks during their Command may place 1 Coin here on an Unbesieged Lord. Then Roman player does the same.
Discard at end of season.
 
Clarification. If the Seljuks choose to take a Coin, they must allow the Roman player to do the same; in this way each player can get at most 2 Coins from this card. Once it is empty of Coins, it stays in play until the end of the Season. Any Unbesieged Lord can receive the Coin. This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S14. MANUEL KOMNENOS FALLS ILL / SUPPORT FROM ALEPPO
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Manuel Komnenos Falls Ill
Shift Manuel Komnenos's Service or cylinder 1 Calendar box.
 
Clarification. This shift can be in either direction, Seljuk player's choice.
 
CAPABILITY - Support from Aleppo (Ibn Khan)
This Lord Command +1 on die roll of 1-3 each of his Command cards.
Discard if this Lord Ravages Aleppo.
 
Clarification. Roll the die before taking any Command actions each time his Command card is revealed.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S15. THEMATIC TROOPS DESERT / NIZAM AL-MULK ADMINISTRATES THE SULTANATE
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Thematic Troops Desert
Alp Arslan in a Thema removes 1 Levied or Unlevied Themata Service marker there.
 
Clarification. The Seljuk player chooses from among the Themata Service Markers, either Levied to the Roman Commander's mat or Unlevied (even Besieged), to remove from play.
 
CAPABILITY - Nizam al-Mulk Administrates the Sultanate (Any)
This Lord may choose not to return to Seat in Winter.
 
Clarification. The Lord may stay in his current Locale, even if Besieging a Stronghold. If he chooses to return, he may not return to another Lord's Seat, another Locale, etc.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S16. NORMAN EXTORTION / PARTHIAN SHOT
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Norman Extortion
Add your Treachery card to this Season's Command Deck during Plan phase (4.1). Roman must add 1 No Command.
 
Clarification. The Treachery card is in addition to the normal Command cards called for by the Season. If both players add their Treachery card in the same turn, both players also still add a No Command to the deck (meaning there will be two extra cards: the Treachery and a No Command) in each. Only one Treachery Event can occur per Arts of War phase. If both are drawn, the second is considered No Event and does not occur.
 
CAPABILITY - Parthian Shot (Any)
This Lord's Turkic Horse select targets during Missile phase in Battle.
 
Clarification. This Capability does not apply in Storm.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S17. UNPREDICTABLE WEATHER / DEEP RAIDS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Unpredictable Weather
This Campaign, if Spring or Autumn, Passes cannot be used for Supply, March, Avoid Battle, or Retreat. If Summer, Plan stack (4.1) is 9 cards. Roman player must use 1 No Command.
 
Clarification. The enemy player adding a No Command happens only if this event occurs in Summer.
 
CAPABILITY - Deep Raids (Any)
In Call to Arms, Disband this Lord in Ikonion for 2 VP or Western Anatolia for 3 VP (place Loot in Mosul and Baghdad Holding Box).
 
Clarification. The Loot placed in the Mosul and Baghdad box reflects the VP earned from this card.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S18. WINTER MARCH / UNSTOPPABLE TURKMEN
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Winter March
HOLD: Play in Winter before Bounty to activate a Seljuk Lord.
 
Clarification. The Seljuk Lord may be Besieged. If both players play Winter Campaign / Winter March at the same time, the Seljuk player goes first, followed by the Roman player.
 
CAPABILITY - Unstoppable Turkmen (Any, except Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
Once per Command, this Lord may Bypass without stopping.
 
Clarification. Laden March still costs the extra Command action. Battle still ends the Command card.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S19. NORMAN PAY REVOLT / BAGHDAD REINFORCEMENTS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Norman Pay Revolt
Add your Treachery card to this Season's Command Deck during Plan phase (4.1). Roman must add 1 No Command.
 
Clarification. The Treachery card is in addition to the normal Command cards called for by the Season. If both players add their Treachery card in the same turn, both players also still add a No Command to the deck (meaning there will be two extra cards: the Treachery and a No Command) in each. Only one Treachery Event can occur per Arts of War phase. If both are drawn, the second is considered No Event and does not occur.
 
CAPABILITY - Baghdad Reinforcements (Any, except Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
Each Muster phase, this Lord at Unbesieged Friendly Locale may restore 1 of his Lost units.
 
Clarification. This restoration of a unit is free and does not cost a Lordship. The recovered unit must be either one of his Levied Vassals or his original Forces.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S20. ALP ARSLAN CONSOLIDATES POWER / ELITE GHULAM CAVALRY
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Alp Arslan Consolidates Power
Lower this year's Seljuk Unity threshold by a number equal to permanently disbanded Seljuk Lords (mark).
 
Clarification. If there are no permanently disbanded Seljuk Lords, this Event has no effect.
 
CAPABILITY - Elite Ghulam Cavalry (Any, except Robert Crépin and Roussel de Bailleul)
Add Ghulam special Vassal to this Lord's mat.
 
Clarification. After spending the Lordship to Muster this Capability and placing the special Vassal marker in the Assets section of his Lord mat, it takes an additional Lordship to Muster the Vassal to the Lord's Forces and receive the unit.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S21. COMMON CULTURAL CAUSE / BRUTAL REPUTATION
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Common Cultural Cause
HOLD: Play in Battle or Storm to remove up to 2 Turkic Horse Themata Service Markers and/or Turkic Horse units at the Active Lord's Locale from play.
 
Clarification. The Active Lord may be Besieged. This can occur to a Lord who only has two Turkic Horse units, thereby causing a Disband.
 
CAPABILITY - Brutal Reputation (Any)
This Lord's Siege action may reroll 1 Surrender die.
 
Clarification. Only one single die may be rerolled. The new roll must be kept.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S22. MASSACRE OF ORTHODOX CLERGY / TURKMEN SKIRMISHERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Massacre of Orthodox Clergy
A Seljuk Lord at Enemy Locale adds 1 Loot.
 
Clarification. The Loot may be obtained regardless of the Locale being Besieged.
 
CAPABILITY - Turkmen Skirmishers (Sanduq al-Turki, Arisighi, and Ibn Khan)
During Wastage, 1 Enemy Lord adjacent to This Lord undergoes Wastage twice.
 
Clarification. The second occurrence of Wastage does not happen if after the first Wastage procedure, the enemy Lord does not qualify for triggering Wastage (i.e., they only have a single Asset of all types on their Lord mat). In the case of multiple adjacent Lords, the Seljuk player chooses which Roman Lord suffers the Wastage.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S23. REINFORCEMENTS DENIED / FORTIFIED GARRISONS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Reinforcements Denied
Shift 1 Roman Lord's Service 1 Calendar box.
 
Clarification. This shift can be in either direction, Seljuk player's choice.
 
CAPABILITY - Fortified Garrisons (ALL)
Each Roman Storm, replace 1 Garrison Militia with Infantry.
 
Clarification. This effect applies during the Array Lords / Play Events step of Storm and only occurs once per Storm (not once per round). This Capability is not attached to any Lord and is placed at the board edge.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S24. BAD OMENS / PRISONERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Bad Omens
HOLD: Play on Seljuk Command card to inspect top 2 Roman Plan cards and replace them in either order.
 
Clarification. This card must be played immediately after revealing a Seljuk Command card, before taking any Command actions.
 
CAPABILITY - Prisoners (Any)
This Lord in Winter Bounty may return 1 Loot beyond Carts.
 
Clarification. A maximum of 1 excess Loot may be returned this way per Winter Bounty.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
S25. MERCENARY DISCIPLINE FALTERS / MULES
----------------------------------------------------------------
EVENT - Mercenary Discipline Falters
Each Roman Lord at Ravaged Locale suffers Wastage now.
 
Clarification. This includes all Roman Lords at a Ravaged Locale, both friendly and enemy Ravaged markers.
 
CAPABILITY - Mules (Any)
This Lord's first March across Pass spends only 1 Command even if Laden.
 
Clarification. This effect applies once each Command card. This effect does not occur for this Lord if stacked under a Lieutenant or being moved by a Commander as part of a Group March.

================================================================
SELJUK — BATTLE AND STORM PROCEDURE REFERENCE
================================================================
Source: Rules of Play sections 4.8-4.9, cross-checked against
Seljuk_Errata_and_Clarifications.txt and the Playbook examples.
Errata corrections applied inline.
 
PRECEDENCE
  Where this file and the Rules of Play or the Errata &
  Clarifications differ, the Rules and the Errata govern.
 
CONVENTIONS
  "Attacker" = the Marching side that triggered the Battle.
  "Defender" = the side already at the Locale.
  Unit stats (Strike values, Protection ranges) are in the
  Units and Strongholds reference file; this document covers
  only the procedural flow.
  All dice are standard d6.
 
 
================================================================
1. BATTLE (4.8)
================================================================
TRIGGER: When a Lord Approaches (4.3.4) an Unbesieged,
Unbypassed Enemy Lord who does not Avoid Battle or Withdraw,
a Battle ensues. All Unbesieged and Unbypassed Lords in the
Locale must participate; others may not.
NOTE: Storm (4.9) follows similar but distinct rules from
field Battle.
 
MARKER: Place the Battle/Storm marker at the Locale.
 
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
1.1  BATTLE ARRAY (4.8.1)
----------------------------------------------------------------
Players Array their Lords — cylinders on the Battle mat or
mats on the table, as preferred.
 
POSITIONING ORDER:
  1. Attackers position their Lords.
  2. Defenders position their Lords.
 
FRONT ROW (up to 3 positions: Left, Center, Right):
  - The Active Lord (whose Command card was revealed) MUST
    start at Front Center.
  - Attackers then fill Front Left and/or Right with one other
    Lord in each, if any.
  - Remaining Attacking Lords go in Reserve.
  - The Defender MUST put one Lord directly opposite each
    Front Attacking Lord, filling Center first, then Left and/or
    Right, as able.
  - Remaining Defending Lords go in Reserve.
 
EVENTS:
  Attacking then Defending sides may play Held Events that
  specify "in Battle" or "in Storm", as applicable (3.1.3).
  NOTE: If CAVALRY CHARGE and COMMAND CONFUSION are
  both played in the same Battle, CAVALRY CHARGE takes
  precedence.
 
RELIEF SALLY (4.8.1):
  When a side Approaches a Locale where it is also Besieged,
  any Besieged Lords may join the Attack for no additional
  Command actions.
  - Array Sallying Attackers in a row behind the Defenders.
  - Any Defending Lords in Reserve instead position opposite
    Sallying Attackers as a Rearguard row.
  - If no Rearguard, Sallying Lords fight Front Defenders as
    if Flanking them all equally closely (4.8.2).
  - Siegeworks (4.9.1) protect against Strikes by Sallying
    Attackers only (round separately).
  - If Attackers lose, Withdraw Sallying Lords back into the
    Stronghold (4.8.3) and reduce Siege markers there to one
    (4.9.2).
 
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
1.2  ROUNDS (4.8.2)
----------------------------------------------------------------
A Battle continues Round after Round until a side Concedes or
all its Lords Rout. Each Round proceeds:
  Step 1: Concede the Field?
  Step 2: Reposition
  Step 3: Strike (Missile, then Melee)
NOTE: Some Battle Event effects vary by Round.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.2.1  CONCEDE THE FIELD? (4.8.2)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
At the start of each Round, Attacker then Defender may declare
the Battle will end after this Round with that side as the loser
but with diminished losses (4.8.3-4).
NOTE: Battles last at least one Round (no Conceding in the
first Round).
 
PURSUIT MARKER: Place the Pursuit marker between the two
sides, pointing toward the Conceding side. The Conceding side
halves its Hits in this final Round (see Strike below).
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.2.2  REPOSITION (4.8.2)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
In each Round AFTER the first, both sides reposition Lords in
this order:
 
  A. ROUT: Remove Routed Lords from the Battle Array. They
     no longer occupy any position nor participate further until
     Ending the Battle (4.8.3).
 
  B. ADJUST ROWS (Relief Sally only): If all of any row
     Routed:
       - If no Sallying Lords remain, Rearguard becomes
         Reserve.
       - If no Rearguard, Sallying Lords Flank Defenders.
       - If no Front Defenders, Rearguard faces about as
         Reserve.
 
  C. ADVANCE LORDS: Attacker then Defender may slide any
     Unrouted Lords in Reserve into any empty Front positions
     (one each).
 
  D. CENTER: If a center position remains empty, first the
     Attacker then the Defender must select and slide one of
     that side's Lords from Left or Right Front to fill the
     empty Front Center.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.2.3  STRIKE (4.8.2)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Forces of each Lord Strike those of the Lord directly opposite,
or if Flanking, the closest enemy Lord in that row.
 
INITIATIVE — Strike steps proceed in this fixed order. Each
lettered step is resolved fully (Hits, Protection, Rout) before
the next step:
 
  1. MISSILE STEPS
     a. Defending Missiles
     b. Attacking Missiles
 
  2. MELEE STEPS
     a. Defending Horse
     b. Attacking Horse
     c. Defending Foot
     d. Attacking Foot
 
Within each step, the Striking side chooses the order of
Strike Lord by Lord (or Lord with Flanking Lord[s]). Then any
Flanking Lords choose whether to absorb Strikes before
opposed Lords. Resolve all Hits, Protection, and Rout before
proceeding to the next step.
 
FLANKING:
  A Lord facing an enemy row with no enemy Lord directly
  opposite Flanks and Strikes the closest enemy Lord in that
  row. A Lord in Center Flanks Left and Right and chooses one
  to Strike.
  Total all Hits from Flanking Lords plus the directly opposed
  Lord, then round up.
  A Flanking Lord may absorb Hits from a Lord he Flanks if no
  enemies Flank the target Lord.
 
TOTAL HITS:
  Each unit causes 1/2, 1, 2, or 3 Hits depending on Forces type
  and Strike type — see the Forces table. Total all Hits for that
  step, including Flanking plus directly opposing Lords, round
  up. NOTE: Hits are automatic based on Forces; you do not
  roll to generate Hits.
 
  MIXED MISSILES: When Garrison Missiles or Missiles that
  choose targets (PARTHIAN SHOT Capability) combine with
  normal Missiles, round Hits in favor of the Garrison or
  Capability Missiles.
 
  PURSUIT: The Conceding side halves its total Hits against
  the Pursuing side. Round all fractions up within each step.
  EXCEPTION: A single Conceding Lord with ONLY Turkic
  Horse units in his Forces at the start of the battle, facing
  only a single opposing Lord, causes BOTH sides to be halved.
 
APPLY HITS TO LORDS:
  Hits apply to the Forces of the opposed, Flanked, or Flanking
  Enemy Lord. A player with a Flanking Lord where no enemies
  are Flanking the target chooses either the Flanking or
  directly opposed Lord to take Hits.
  Whenever a Lord Routs to create a new Flanking situation,
  apply remaining Hits accordingly.
 
ROLL WALLS (Storm/Sally only):
  A Lord benefiting from any Walls or any Siege markers first
  rolls dice equal to the total Hits just received in that step
  BEFORE assigning any Hits to units.
  Each roll within the Walls range specified (typically 1-4) or
  less than or equal to the total Siege markers cancels one Hit.
  Roll Hits that differ from others (such as -2 Armor) separately.
 
ASSIGN HITS TO UNITS:
  After rolling for any Walls, the owner chooses which unit
  absorbs each Hit, Hit by Hit.
  EXCEPTIONS:
    - Select Target: Garrison Missiles and PARTHIAN SHOT
      allow the Striking side to select which enemy unit takes
      each such Hit. The player receiving Hits first chooses a
      Lord to be affected (when Flanking), then the Striking
      side Selects Target units for those Hits; the owner
      chooses units for any other Hits.
    - Storm Attack: Hits against a side Attacking in Storm
      must be applied to Armored before Unarmored units,
      regardless of who is choosing (4.9.1).
  IMPORTANT: A unit may absorb several Hits in succession,
  shielding fellow units, as long as it succeeds on each
  Protection roll.
 
ROLL PROTECTION BY HIT:
  Units roll Protection as follows:
 
  ARMOR: A unit with any Armor Protection rolls a die. A roll
  within the Armor range specified (Forces table or card) means
  the Hit has no effect (no Rout).
 
  EVADE: Units with Evade Protection roll and absorb Hits
  just as if Armored, EXCEPT Evade is NOT used against:
    - Missile Hits, OR
    - Hits in Storm.
 
  GARRISON MISSILES: Missile Hits from Stronghold Garrisons
  roll against Armor reduced by -1, to a minimum Armor of "1".
 
  UNARMORED: Militia avoid Routing on a Hit only on a roll
  of 1.
 
ROUT:
  A unit is Routed as soon as it fails to negate a Hit with a
  successful Protection roll. Slide it to the "Routed" section
  of the Lord's mat. Routed units no longer Strike nor absorb
  Hits in that Battle.
 
  A Lord Routs when his last Unrouted unit Routs. Remove him
  from the Array. A new Flanking situation may immediately
  result. When an entire row Routs, ignore remaining Hits
  against that row.
 
  Track Themata status by keeping their units on their marker.
  NOTE: When a Themata marker with more than one unit has
  only one unit Rout, track which units belong to the Themata
  until Battle ends.
 
NEW ROUND:
  If neither side Conceded AND at least one Lord on each side
  has yet to Rout, begin a new Round at "Concede the Field?"
  Otherwise, end per 1.3 below.
 
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
1.3  ENDING THE BATTLE (4.8.3)
----------------------------------------------------------------
A side that Conceded at the start of the Round OR that has no
Unrouted Lords (when the other side did not Concede) loses the
Battle at the end of that Round.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.3.1  RETREAT, WITHDRAWAL, OR REMOVAL (4.8.3)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
All losing Lords must either:
  A. RETREAT to a single adjacent Locale with no Enemy Lords
     or Strongholds that are not already Besieged or Bypassed
     (4.3.5), OR
  B. WITHDRAW into a Friendly Stronghold at the Battle Locale
     (if Sallied or is Defending at one), OR
  C. Be REMOVED per 4.8.5 below.
 
The owning player chooses each Lord's fate, within these
requirements:
  - Defenders may NOT Retreat along any part of the Way that
    Attackers used to Approach the Locale.
  - Marching Attackers MUST Retreat to the Locale whence
    they Approached (4.3.4).
    [ERRATA APPLIED — Playbook p.17: Attackers may NOT
    Withdraw into the Stronghold at the site of Battle because
    they are neither the Defender nor Sallying.]
  - Sallying Attackers MUST Withdraw back into their
    Stronghold.
  - Retreating Lords may join Friendly Lords already Bypassing
    an Enemy Stronghold (4.8.3 rules, Seljuk summary of
    changes).
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.3.2  LOSSES (4.8.4)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
After losing Lords Retreat, Withdraw, or are removed, BOTH
sides determine the fate of their Routed units:
 
  Roll a die for each Routed unit:
 
  HARSH LOSSES (Protection = 1 only):
    - All Routed units of Lords who Retreated WITHOUT having
      Conceded the Field (4.8.2), OR
    - Who were Attacking in Storm (4.9.1)
    ...fail unless they roll a "1".
 
  NORMAL LOSSES:
    - For Routed units of all other Lords (even if the Lord
      Routed after Conceding the Field), compare each unit's
      roll to its inherent Protection as shown on the Forces
      table, UNMODIFIED by Events or Capabilities.
 
  RESULTS:
    - Units that roll within Protection range: no longer
      Routed — push above the line on the mat. (Service
      Markers stay put.)
    - Units that fail: Lost — remove to pool.
    - Once a Themata Service Marker has all its units Lost in
      Battle, the Service Marker is removed from the game.
    - For a Lord who loses ALL his Forces in Battle or Storm,
      remove him per 4.8.5 below.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.3.3  SPOILS (4.8.3)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Lords on the losing side may have to immediately transfer
Assets to Lords on the winning side. The winning player
distributes these Assets among mats of Lords at the Locale:
 
  - Lords who WITHDREW: keep all their Assets.
  - Lords who CONCEDED and RETREATED: transfer all Loot
    and any Provender beyond that which they could move
    without being Laden (4.3.2). Lose no other Assets.
  - Losing Lords who were REMOVED (unable to Retreat or
    Withdraw, or by Losses), or who RETREATED WITHOUT
    HAVING CONCEDED the Field: transfer ALL their Assets.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.3.4  SERVICE (4.8.3)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The losing side rolls one die for EACH of its Retreated Lords
and shifts that Lord's Service Marker (and, if using Vassal
Service optional rule 6.2, each of his Vassals' markers) left:
  - Roll 1, 2, or 3: shift left 1 box.
  - Roll 4, 5, or 6: shift left 2 boxes.
 
  - Losing Lords who WITHDREW into a Stronghold do NOT
    shift their Service.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.3.5  LORD REMOVAL BY COMBAT (4.8.5)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Lords removed in Battle (4.8.3-4) or Storm (4.9.1) — by failure
to Retreat or Withdraw, Loss of all Forces, or Sack — suffer
removal as if Disbanding Beyond Service (3.3.1).
NOTE: Later Disband due to Service Limit (3.3) does not count
as removal by combat, even if Battle caused a shortening of
Service.
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
1.3.6  AFTERMATH (4.8.6)
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
After resolving Spoils and Losses:
 
  A. MOVED/FOUGHT: Mark all Attacking and Defending Lords
     Moved/Fought (if not already marked).
  B. EVENTS: Discard all Hold Events (3.1.3) used in this
     Battle or Storm.
  C. SIEGE: If the combat created or ended a Siege, adjust
     Siege, Conquered, Ruins, and/or Victory markers (1.3.1,
     4.3.5, 4.9.1, 5.1).
  D. RECOVERY: Skip any Command actions remaining on this
     card. Go to Feed/Pay/Disband (4.6).
 
  IMPORTANT: A Battle or Storm blocks any further Command
  actions on the current Command card.
 
 
================================================================
2. STORM (4.9.1)
================================================================
Any Lord outside a Besieged Stronghold may use a Command
action to launch an Attack. Proceed per Battle rules (4.8)
EXCEPT as modified below. Refer to the Battle and Storm chart.
NOTE: Some Events and Capabilities apply to Battle but not
Storm, or vice versa.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.1  STORM ARRAY
----------------------------------------------------------------
Follow Battle rules (4.8.1-4.8.2) EXCEPT:
  - Each side's Front row begins with AT MOST ONE Lord (for
    the Attacker, the Active Lord).
  - All other Lords start in Reserve.
  - More Lords may later Reposition to the Front, up to the
    Stronghold's Size (1, 2, or 3).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.2  STORM CONCEDE
----------------------------------------------------------------
At the start of each Round AFTER the first, the Attacker (only)
may end the Storm. The Attacker loses. Go to Ending the Storm.
The Defender may NOT Concede in a Storm.
NOTE: Neither side may Concede in the first Round.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.3  STORM REPOSITION
----------------------------------------------------------------
In each Storm Round after the first, Attacker then Defender may
add one Lord from Reserve to the Front, up to Stronghold Size
(1, 2, or 3).
A Reserve Lord (if any present) MUST move to Front if all of
their Front Lords Routed, or MUST move to Front to match an
enemy Front Lord.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.4  STRONGHOLD EFFECTS
----------------------------------------------------------------
GARRISON FORCES:
  - The Besieged side receives the Garrison units (and for
    Romans, any present Themata Service Markers chosen to
    defend the Stronghold at the start of the Siege) shown for
    that type of Stronghold on the Strongholds table.
  - Current Allegiance of the Stronghold determines which
    column (Roman or Seljuk) is used on the Strongholds
    player aid card.
  - Strongholds in the Fatimid Caliphate (1.3.1) always use
    the Seljuk Garrison column.
  - In the rare case the pool has too few pieces, do not place
    those units.
 
GARRISON FORCES DURING STORM:
  - Garrison Foot units have both Melee and Missiles.
  - Garrison Infantry and Militia are x1/2 Missile units that
    SELECT Enemy targets (4.8.2) with -1 to Enemy Armor.
  - Garrisons add their Strikes to those of the Defending Lord
    (rounding up), if any, but do not otherwise affect the Lord's
    Strikes. Garrisons are separate from any Defending Lord
    and ignore cards affecting that Lord individually.
  - The Defender MUST assign all Hits suffered to Garrison
    units until they are Routed, after which the Front Defending
    Lord's units (if any) absorb Hits.
  - Whenever Routed and at the end of the Storm, return
    Garrison units to the pool.
  - The full complement of Garrison units Defends in EACH
    enemy Storm action, regardless of what happened in
    previous Storm actions.
 
WALLS:
  The Besieged side uses that Stronghold's Walls per 4.8.2
  and the Strongholds table.
 
SIEGEWORKS:
  The Besieging side places all Siege markers at the Locale
  in front of its Attacking Lord(s). Those Lords during the
  Storm have Walls with Value equal to the number of Siege
  markers against both Missile and Melee Strikes.
  EXAMPLE: Lords Storming with 3 Siege markers benefit
  from Walls 1-3.
 
MELEE ORDER IN STORM:
  All Defending units Melee Strike BEFORE any Attacking
  units do, unlike Battle where Horse Melee precedes Foot
  (4.8.2). The Storm Strike sequence is:
 
  1. MISSILE STEPS
     a. Defending Missiles (including Garrison Missiles)
     b. Attacking Missiles
 
  2. MELEE STEPS
     a. Defending Horse Melee
     b. Defending Foot Melee
     c. Attacking Horse Melee
     d. Attacking Foot Melee
 
STORM ATTACK RESTRICTION:
  Hits against a side Attacking in Storm MUST be applied to
  Armored units before Unarmored units, regardless of who is
  choosing.
 
MELEE CAP:
  Each Lord of each side in Storm adds no more than 6 Hits in
  Melee. (Missiles are unlimited.)
 
EVADE RESTRICTION:
  Evade Protection is NOT used against Hits in Storm (see
  1.2.3 Protection rules above).
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.5  ENDING THE STORM
----------------------------------------------------------------
A Storm ends once the number of Rounds COMPLETED equals
the number of Siege markers there, or earlier if:
  - A side loses because all its Lords Rout, OR
  - The Attacker Concedes.
 
ATTACKER LOSES (Defenders NOT all Routed):
  - Losing Attackers neither Retreat nor give up Spoils.
  - The Locale remains Besieged — return Siege markers to
    the map and go to Aftermath (4.8.6).
 
DEFENDER LOSES:
  - Sack the Stronghold (see 2.6 below).
  - If Defenders win, any Themata Service Markers garrisoning
    the Stronghold remain.
 
LOSSES:
  Both sides' Forces take Losses per Battle (4.8.4), EXCEPT:
    - Routed Defending units always roll against their inherent
      Protection.
    - Routed Attacking units that fail to roll a "1" are removed.
 
MOVED/FOUGHT:
  Mark ALL Lords at the Storm Locale as Moved/Fought, even
  Lords who remained in Reserve.
  NOTE: Lords at a Storm Locale may not simply sit it out.
  Used or not, they showed up for action.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.6  SACK (4.9.1)
----------------------------------------------------------------
When Besieged Defenders lose a Storm:
 
  A. CONQUER: The Besiegers Conquer the Stronghold. Remove
     Siege markers. Place or remove Conquered markers (1.3.1).
     EXCEPTION: In the Fatimid Caliphate, the Roman player
     only removes Seljuk Conquered markers and does not place
     their own.
     If the Stronghold now has a Ravaged marker that is the
     same color as its Allegiance printed on the map, flip it to
     the opposite color.
     If the Stronghold has a Roman Strategic Objective marker,
     the Roman player claims it in the Constantinople Holding
     Box.
     Adjust VP marker on the Calendar (2.2.5, 5.1).
 
  B. RUIN (Seljuk only, Roman Empire Strongholds only):
     Instead of Conquering, the Seljuk player may choose to
     Ruin it. Remove all Siege markers (1.3.1, 4.5.1). Place
     one Ruins marker. Adjust VPs (2.2.5, 5.1).
 
  C. AWARD SPOILS: Besieging Lords receive and distribute
     as desired among their mats a number of Loot, Provender,
     and Coin each according to the Stronghold's Value (1, 2,
     or 3; see Strongholds table) plus all Assets from
     Disbanding Lords.
     EXAMPLE: Sacking a Town yields 2 Provender and 1 Coin.
 
  D. REMOVE LORDS: Remove each losing Lord per 4.8.5 —
     Disband him as if Beyond Service (3.3.1).
 
  E. REMOVE THEMATA: Remove each losing Themata Service
     Marker (1.5.1), eliminating them from the game.
 
AFTERMATH: Proceed with Aftermath (4.8.6).
 
 
================================================================
3. SALLY (4.9.2)
================================================================
A Besieged Lord may use a Command action to Attack Besiegers
in a Battle. Follow Battle rules (4.8), including skipping any
remaining Command actions (4.8.6), EXCEPT:
 
ARRAY AND REPOSITION:
  Each side begins with one Lord in Front (for the Attacker,
  the Active Lord); other Lords start in Reserve. In each Round
  after the first, Attacker then Defender may add one Lord
  from Reserve to the Front, up to Stronghold Size (1, 2, or 3).
  If all Front Lords Routed, a Reserve Lord (if any present)
  must move to Front.
  NOTE: Sally positioning mimics Storm (4.9.1).
 
SIEGEWORKS:
  Defenders (the Besiegers being Sallied against) receive
  Siegeworks as if Storming (4.9.1).
  NOTE: Sallying Attackers do NOT receive any Walls or
  Garrison.
 
END:
  Losing Defenders (Besiegers) Retreat normally, ending the
  Siege.
  Losing Attackers (the Besieged Sallying force) must Withdraw
  back into their Stronghold (4.8.3, not Retreat).
 
RAID:
  If Sallying Attackers lose, remove all but one Siege marker
  at the Locale (reflecting damage to Siegeworks by the
  sortie). The Siege goes on.
 
 
================================================================
QUICK REFERENCE: BATTLE FLOW SUMMARY
================================================================
  1. Approach triggers Battle (4.3.4)
  2. Array Lords (4.8.1)
     - Attacker positions, then Defender
     - Play Held "in Battle" Events
  3. ROUND (repeat until Battle ends):
     a. Concede the Field? (Attacker, then Defender; not Round 1)
     b. Reposition (Rounds 2+: remove Routed, adjust rows,
        advance Reserve Lords, fill Center)
     c. Strike:
        i.   Defending Missiles → Hits → Protection → Rout
        ii.  Attacking Missiles → Hits → Protection → Rout
        iii. Defending Horse Melee → Hits → Protection → Rout
        iv.  Attacking Horse Melee → Hits → Protection → Rout
        v.   Defending Foot Melee → Hits → Protection → Rout
        vi.  Attacking Foot Melee → Hits → Protection → Rout
     d. New Round? (if neither Conceded and both sides have
        Unrouted Lords, go to 3a; else end)
  4. Ending the Battle (4.8.3)
     a. Retreat / Withdrawal / Removal
     b. Losses (both sides roll for Routed units)
     c. Spoils (losing side transfers Assets)
     d. Service (losing Retreated Lords shift left)
  5. Aftermath (4.8.6)
     a. Mark Moved/Fought
     b. Discard used Hold Events
     c. Adjust Siege/Conquered/Ruins/VP markers
     d. Skip remaining actions → Feed/Pay/Disband (4.6)
 
 
================================================================
QUICK REFERENCE: STORM FLOW SUMMARY
================================================================
  1. Lord uses Command action to Storm (4.5.2, 4.9.1)
  2. Array Lords (one per side in Front; rest in Reserve)
     - Place Siege markers as Siegeworks for Attacker
     - Place Walls markers for Defender
     - Defender receives Garrison units and any Themata
     - Play Held "in Storm" Events
  3. ROUND (repeat up to # of Siege markers):
     a. Concede? (Attacker only; not Round 1)
     b. Reposition (add 1 Lord per side to Front, up to
        Stronghold Size)
     c. Strike:
        i.   Defending Missiles (incl. Garrison) → Walls →
             Assign → Protection → Rout
        ii.  Attacking Missiles → Siegeworks → Assign
             (Armored first) → Protection (no Evade) → Rout
        iii. Defending Horse Melee → same
        iv.  Defending Foot Melee → same
        v.   Attacking Horse Melee (max 6 Hits/Lord) → same
        vi.  Attacking Foot Melee (max 6 Hits/Lord) → same
     d. New Round? (if Rounds completed < Siege markers and
        neither side fully Routed and Attacker did not Concede,
        go to 3a; else end)
  4. Ending the Storm (4.9.1)
     - If Defenders lose → Sack (Conquer or Ruin, Award
       Spoils, Remove Lords, Remove Themata)
     - If Attackers lose → no Retreat, no Spoils given; Siege
       continues; return Siege markers to map
     - Losses (Routed Attackers need "1"; Routed Defenders
       roll normal Protection)
  5. Aftermath (4.8.6)
     - All Lords at Locale marked Moved/Fought
     - Discard used Hold Events
     - Adjust markers
     - Skip remaining actions → Feed/Pay/Disband (4.6)
